Challenge: [MLH] Best Use of Gemini API
Collected brief: It’s time to push the boundaries of what’s possible with AI using Google Gemini. Check out the Gemini API to build AI-powered apps that make your friends say WHOA. So, what can Gemini do for your hackathon project?
Understand language like a human and build a chatbot that gives personalized advice
Analyze info like a supercomputer and create an app that summarizes complex research papers
Generate creative content like code, scripts, music, and more
Think of the possibilities… what will you build with the Google Gemini API this weekend?
Relevance measures meaningful Gemini API use: 1 absent, 2 incidental/swappable, 3 meaningful secondary role, 4 central, 5 built around Gemini. A tag alone is not evidence of an integration.
